chapter_title.ar: باب مَوْلِدِ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام )
chapter_title.en: Chapter 124 –Arrival of Abu Muhammad Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>)

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف بأحمد - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (6/138)

chunks.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:

translations.bn: আলী ইবন মুহাম্মদ, মুহাম্মদ ইবন ইসমাঈল ইবন ইব্রাহিম ইবন মূসা ইবন জাফর থেকে, তিনি বলেন:
translations.de: Ali ibn Muhammad, von Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ibn Musa ibn Ja'far, der sagte:
translations.en: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ibn Musa ibn Ja'far, who said:
translations.es: Ali ibn Muhammad, de Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ibn Musa ibn Ja'far, quien dijo:
translations.fa: علی بن محمد، از محمد بن اسماعیل بن ابراهیم بن موسی بن جعفر، که گفت:
translations.fr: Ali ibn Muhammad, de Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ibn Musa ibn Ja'far, qui a dit :
translations.id: Ali ibn Muhammad, dari Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ibn Musa ibn Ja'far, ia berkata:
translations.ru: Али ибн Мухаммад, от Мухаммада ибн Исма'ила ибн Ибрахима ибн Мусы ибн Джа'фара, который сказал:
translations.tr: Ali ibn Muhammad, Muhammed ibn İsmail ibn İbrahim ibn Musa ibn Ca'fer'den, dedi ki:
translations.ur: علی بن محمد، محمد بن اسماعیل بن ابراہیم بن موسیٰ بن جعفر سے، انہوں نے کہا:
translations.zh: 阿里·伊本·穆罕默德，传自穆罕默德·伊本·伊斯马仪·伊本·易卜拉欣·伊本·穆萨·伊本·贾法尔，他说：

chunks.arabic_text: كَتَبَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ (عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ) إِلَى أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الزُّبَيْرِيِّ قَبْلَ مَوْتِ الْمُعْتَزِّ بِنَحْوِ عِشْرِينَ يَوْمًا: الْزَمْ بَيْتَكَ حَتَّى يَحْدُثَ الْحَادِثُ. فَلَمَّا قُتِلَ بُرَيْحَةُ، كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ: قَدْ حَدَثَ الْحَادِثُ، فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي؟ فَكَتَبَ: لَيْسَ هَذَا الْحَادِثَ، هُوَ الْحَادِثُ الْآخَرُ. فَكَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُعْتَزِّ مَا كَانَ.

translations.bn: আবু মুহাম্মদ (عليه السلام) আল-মু‘তাজ্জের মৃত্যুর প্রায় বিশ দিন আগে আবু আল-কাসিম ইসহাক ইবন জাফর আল-জুবাইরিকে লিখেছিলেন: "ঘটনাটি না ঘটা পর্যন্ত তোমার ঘরেই থাকো।" তারপর যখন বুরাইহা নিহত হলো, তিনি তাকে লিখলেন: "ঘটনাটি ঘটে গেছে, তাহলে আপনি আমাকে কী আদেশ করেন?" তিনি জবাব লিখলেন: "এটি সেই ঘটনাটি নয়; এটি অন্য ঘটনাটি।" এরপর আল-মু‘তাজ্জ সম্পর্কে যা ঘটার তা-ই ঘটল।
translations.de: Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) schrieb etwa zwanzig Tage vor dem Tod von al-Mu'tazz an Abu al-Qasim Ishaq ibn Ja'far al-Zubayri: „Bleibe in deinem Haus, bis das Ereignis eintritt.“ Als dann Burayhah getötet wurde, schrieb er ihm: „Das Ereignis ist eingetreten; was befiehlst du mir zu tun?“ Er schrieb zurück: „Dies ist nicht das Ereignis; es ist das andere Ereignis.“ Dann geschah in Bezug auf al-Mu'tazz, was geschah.
translations.en: Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) wrote to Abu al-Qasim Ishaq ibn Ja'far al-Zubayri about twenty days before the death of al-Mu'tazz: "Remain in your house until the event occurs." Then, when Burayhah was killed, he wrote to him: "The event has occurred, so what do you order me to do?" He wrote back: "This is not the event; it is the other event." Then there occurred, regarding al-Mu'tazz, what occurred.
translations.es: Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) escribió a Abu al-Qasim Ishaq ibn Ja'far al-Zubayri unos veinte días antes de la muerte de al-Mu'tazz: "Permanece en tu casa hasta que ocurra el acontecimiento." Luego, cuando Burayhah fue قتلado, le escribió: "El acontecimiento ha ocurrido, entonces ¿qué me ordenas hacer?" Él respondió por escrito: "Este no es el acontecimiento; es el otro acontecimiento." Entonces ocurrió, respecto de al-Mu'tazz, lo que ocurrió.
translations.fa: ابومحمد (عليه السلام) حدود بیست روز پیش از مرگِ معتز به ابوالقاسم اسحاق بن جعفر زبیری نوشت: «در خانه‌ات بمان تا آن رخداد واقع شود.» سپس هنگامی که بریحه کشته شد، به او نوشت: «رخداد واقع شد، پس به من چه فرمان می‌دهی؟» او نوشت: «این آن رخداد نیست؛ آن رخدادِ دیگر است.» سپس دربارهٔ معتز آنچه رخ داد، رخ داد.
translations.fr: Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) écrivit à Abu al-Qasim Ishaq ibn Ja'far al-Zubayri environ vingt jours avant la mort d'al-Mu'tazz : « Reste dans ta maison jusqu'à ce que l'événement se produise. » Puis, lorsque Burayhah fut tué, il lui écrivit : « L'événement s'est produit, alors que m'ordonnes-tu de faire ? » Il répondit par écrit : « Ce n'est pas cet événement ; c'est l'autre événement. » Puis se produisit, au sujet d'al-Mu'tazz, ce qui se produisit.
translations.id: Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) menulis kepada Abu al-Qasim Ishaq ibn Ja'far al-Zubayri sekitar dua puluh hari sebelum wafatnya al-Mu'tazz: "Tetaplah di rumahmu sampai peristiwa itu terjadi." Lalu ketika Burayhah dibunuh, ia menulis kepadanya: "Peristiwa itu telah terjadi, lalu apa yang engkau perintahkan kepadaku?" Ia membalas: "Ini bukan peristiwa itu; itu adalah peristiwa yang lain." Kemudian terjadilah, mengenai al-Mu'tazz, apa yang terjadi.
translations.ru: Абу Мухаммад (عليه السلام) написал Абу аль-Касиму Исхаку ибн Джа'фару аз-Зубайри примерно за двадцать дней до смерти аль-Му'тазза: «Оставайся в своем доме, пока не произойдет событие». Затем, когда Бурейха был убит, он написал ему: «Событие произошло, так что же ты мне приказываешь?» Он написал в ответ: «Это не то событие; это другое событие». Затем относительно аль-Му'тазза произошло то, что произошло.
translations.tr: Ebu Muhammed (عليه السلام), el-Mu'tazz'ın ölümünden yaklaşık yirmi gün önce Ebu'l-Kasım İshak ibn Ca'fer ez-Zübeyrî'ye şöyle yazdı: "Olay gerçekleşinceye kadar evinde kal." Sonra Burayha öldürüldüğünde ona şöyle yazdı: "Olay gerçekleşti; peki bana ne emredersin?" O da şöyle yazdı: "Bu olay değildir; o başka olaydır." Ardından el-Mu'tazz hakkında olan oldu.
translations.ur: ابو محمد (عليه السلام) نے ابو القاسم اسحاق بن جعفر الزبیری کو المعتز کی وفات سے تقریباً بیس دن پہلے لکھا: "اپنے گھر میں رہو یہاں تک کہ واقعہ پیش آ جائے۔" پھر جب بریحہ قتل ہوا تو انہوں نے اسے لکھا: "واقعہ پیش آ گیا ہے، تو آپ مجھے کیا حکم دیتے ہیں؟" انہوں نے جواب لکھا: "یہ وہ واقعہ نہیں ہے؛ وہ دوسرا واقعہ ہے۔" پھر المعتز کے بارے میں وہی ہوا جو ہوا۔
translations.zh: 阿布·穆罕默德（عليه السلام）在穆尔塔兹去世前约二十天写信给阿布·卡西姆·伊斯哈格·伊本·贾法尔·祖拜里："你就待在家里，直到那件事发生。"后来布赖哈被杀时，他又写信给他："那件事已经发生了，那么你命令我怎么做？"他回信说："这不是那件事；那是另一件事。"随后，关于穆尔塔兹，事情果然发生了。

chunks.arabic_text: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ آخَرَ: يُقْتَلُ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَبْلَ قَتْلِهِ بِعَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي الْيَوْمِ الْعَاشِرِ قُتِلَ.

translations.bn: এবং তাঁর কাছ থেকে বর্ণিত, তিনি বলেন: তিনি আরেকজন লোককে লিখেছিলেন: "মুহাম্মদ ইবন দাউদের পুত্র, আবদুল্লাহ, তার নিহত হওয়ার দশ দিন আগে নিহত হবে।" তারপর দশম দিন এলে তাকে হত্যা করা হলো।
translations.de: Und von ihm wird berichtet, dass er sagte: Er schrieb an einen anderen Mann: „Der Sohn von Muhammad ibn Dawud, 'Abd Allah, wird getötet werden“, zehn Tage vor seiner Tötung. Als dann der zehnte Tag kam, wurde er getötet.
translations.en: And from him, he said: He wrote to another man: "The son of Muhammad ibn Dawud, 'Abd Allah, will be killed," ten days before his killing. Then, when the tenth day came, he was killed.
translations.es: Y de él se narra que dijo: Escribió a otro hombre: "El hijo de Muhammad ibn Dawud, 'Abd Allah, será asesinado", diez días antes de que lo mataran. Luego, cuando llegó el décimo día, fue asesinado.
translations.fa: و از او روایت شده که گفت: به مرد دیگری نوشت: «پسر محمد بن داود، عبدالله، ده روز پیش از کشته شدنش کشته خواهد شد.» سپس چون روز دهم فرا رسید، کشته شد.
translations.fr: Et de lui, il a dit : Il écrivit à un autre homme : « Le fils de Muhammad ibn Dawud, 'Abd Allah, sera tué », dix jours avant qu'il ne soit tué. Puis, lorsque le dixième jour arriva, il fut tué.
translations.id: Dan darinya, ia berkata: Ia menulis kepada seorang laki-laki lain: "Putra Muhammad ibn Dawud, 'Abd Allah, akan dibunuh," sepuluh hari sebelum pembunuhannya. Lalu ketika hari kesepuluh tiba, ia dibunuh.
translations.ru: И от него передается, что он сказал: Он написал другому человеку: «Сын Мухаммада ибн Давуда, 'Абд Аллах, будет убит» за десять дней до его убийства. Затем, когда наступил десятый день, он был убит.
translations.tr: Ve ondan rivayetle, dedi ki: Başka bir adama, öldürülmesinden on gün önce, "Muhammed ibn Davud'un oğlu Abdullah öldürülecek" diye yazdı. Sonra onuncu gün geldiğinde öldürüldü.
translations.ur: اور انہی سے روایت ہے، انہوں نے کہا: انہوں نے ایک اور شخص کو لکھا: "محمد بن داؤد کے بیٹے، عبد اللہ، کو قتل کر دیا جائے گا"، اس کے قتل سے دس دن پہلے۔ پھر جب دسویں دن آیا تو وہ قتل کر دیا گیا۔
translations.zh: 又据他传述，他说：他在被杀前十天写信给另一个人："穆罕默德·伊本·达伍德之子阿卜杜拉将被杀。"后来到了第十天，他就被杀了。

narrators.name_ar: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ

en.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: Abu Muhammad, the appellation of Imam al-Hasan al-'Askari (عليه السلام)
en.الْمُعْتَزِّ: al-Mu'tazz, the Abbasid caliph referred to in the report
en.الْيَوْمِ الْعَاشِرِ: the tenth day, marking the exact fulfillment of the report
en.بُرَيْحَةُ: Burayhah, whose killing prompted the inquiry
en.يُقْتَلُ: will be killed; a prediction of impending death

seo_questions.bn: আল-কাফির এই হাদিসে আবু মুহাম্মদ (عليه السلام)-এর আল-মু‘তাজ্জের পতন পূর্বাভাস দেওয়া সম্পর্কে কী বলা হয়েছে?
seo_questions.de: Was sagt dieser Hadith aus al-Kafi darüber, dass Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) den Sturz von al-Mu'tazz vorhersagte?
seo_questions.en: What does this hadith from al-Kafi say about Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) foretelling the fall of al-Mu'tazz?
seo_questions.es: ¿Qué dice este hadiz de al-Kafi sobre la predicción de Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) acerca de la caída de al-Mu'tazz?
seo_questions.fa: این حدیثِ الکافی دربارهٔ پیشگوییِ سقوطِ معتز توسط ابومحمد (عليه السلام) چه می‌گوید؟
seo_questions.fr: Que dit ce hadith d'al-Kafi au sujet de la prédiction par Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) de la chute d'al-Mu'tazz ?
seo_questions.id: Apa yang dikatakan hadis dari al-Kafi ini tentang Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) yang meramalkan jatuhnya al-Mu'tazz?
seo_questions.ru: Что говорит этот хадис из аль-Кафи о предсказании Абу Мухаммадом (عليه السلام) падения аль-Му'тазза?
seo_questions.tr: el-Kâfî'deki bu hadis, Ebu Muhammed'in (عليه السلام) el-Mu'tazz'ın düşüşünü önceden haber vermesi hakkında ne söyler?
seo_questions.ur: الکافی کی اس حدیث میں ابو محمد (عليه السلام) نے المعتز کے زوال کی پیش گوئی کے بارے میں کیا فرمایا؟
seo_questions.zh: 这段来自《卡菲》的圣训关于阿布·穆罕默德（عليه السلام）预言穆尔塔兹垮台说了什么？

summaries.bn: এই বর্ণনাটি আবু মুহাম্মদ (عليه السلام)-এর পক্ষ থেকে রাজনৈতিক অস্থিরতা এবং নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তিদের মৃত্যু সম্পর্কে পূর্বজ্ঞান জানানোর কথা তুলে ধরে। এতে ইমামের আসন্ন ঘটনাবলির সুনির্দিষ্ট ইঙ্গিত এবং আল-মু‘তাজ্জের পতনের ঐতিহাসিক প্রেক্ষাপটে তাঁর পত্রালাপকে স্থাপন করা হয়েছে।
summaries.de: Diese Überlieferung berichtet von einer Vorankündigung durch Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) über politische Unruhen und den Tod bestimmter Personen. Sie hebt die genaue Ankündigung kommender Ereignisse durch den Imam hervor und ordnet seine Korrespondenz in den historischen Kontext des Sturzes von al-Mu'tazz ein.
summaries.en: This narration reports foreknowledge conveyed by Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) concerning political upheaval and the death of specific individuals. It highlights the Imam's precise indication of coming events and situates his correspondence within the historical context of the fall of al-Mu'tazz.
summaries.es: Esta narración informa de un conocimiento previo transmitido por Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) acerca de la agitación política y la muerte de ciertas personas. Destaca la indicación precisa del Imam sobre los acontecimientos venideros y sitúa su correspondencia en el contexto histórico de la caída de al-Mu'tazz.
summaries.fa: این روایت از خبر دادنِ پیشاپیشِ ابومحمد (عليه السلام) دربارهٔ آشوب‌های سیاسی و مرگِ برخی افراد سخن می‌گوید. این روایت، اشارهٔ دقیق امام به رخدادهای آینده و مکاتبهٔ ایشان را در بستر تاریخیِ سقوطِ معتز قرار می‌دهد.
summaries.fr: Ce récit rapporte une connaissance préalable transmise par Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) au sujet des troubles politiques et de la mort de certaines personnes. Il met en lumière l'indication précise de l'Imam concernant les événements à venir et situe sa correspondance dans le contexte historique de la chute d'al-Mu'tazz.
summaries.id: Riwayat ini mengabarkan pengetahuan sebelumnya yang disampaikan oleh Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) tentang gejolak politik dan kematian orang-orang tertentu. Ini menyoroti penunjukan Imam yang tepat atas peristiwa-peristiwa yang akan datang dan menempatkan korespondensinya dalam konteks historis jatuhnya al-Mu'tazz.
summaries.ru: Этот хадис сообщает о предварительном знании, переданном Абу Мухаммадом (عليه السلام), относительно политических потрясений и смерти определенных людей. Он подчеркивает точное указание Имама на грядущие события и помещает его переписку в исторический контекст падения аль-Му'тазза.
summaries.tr: Bu rivayet, Ebu Muhammed'in (عليه السلام) siyasi çalkantılar ve belirli kişilerin ölümü hakkında önceden verdiği haberi anlatır. İmamın gelecek olayları tam olarak işaret etmesini ve mektuplaşmasını el-Mu'tazz'ın düşüşünün tarihsel bağlamına yerleştirir.
summaries.ur: یہ روایت ابو محمد (عليه السلام) کی طرف سے بعض افراد کے بارے میں پیشگی خبر دینے کو بیان کرتی ہے، خاص طور پر سیاسی ہلچل اور مخصوص اشخاص کی موت کے بارے میں۔ اس میں امام کے آنے والے واقعات کی دقیق نشاندہی اور المعتز کے زوال کے تاریخی پس منظر میں ان کی مراسلت کو نمایاں کیا گیا ہے۔
summaries.zh: 这段传述讲述了阿布·穆罕默德（عليه السلام）所传达的先知性消息，涉及政治动荡和某些人的死亡。它突出伊玛目对将来事件的准确指示，并将他的通信置于穆尔塔兹垮台的历史背景中。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف بأحمد - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (6/138)

parts.text: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ

text: كَتَبَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ ( عليه السلام ) إِلَى أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الزُّبَيْرِيِّ قَبْلَ مَوْتِ الْمُعْتَزِّ بِنَحْوِ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً الْزَمْ بَيْتَكَ حَتَّى يَحْدُثَ الْحَادِثُ فَلَمَّا قُتِلَ بُرَيْحَةُ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ قَدْ حَدَثَ الْحَادِثُ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي فَكَتَبَ لَيْسَ هَذَا الْحَادِثَ هُوَ الْحَادِثُ الْآخَرُ فَكَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُعْتَزِّ مَا كَانَ
وَ عَنْهُ قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ آخَرَ يُقْتَلُ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَبْلَ قَتْلِهِ بِعَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي الْيَوْمِ الْعَاشِرِ قُتِلَ .

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Ibrahim Bin Musa Bin Ja’far who said,

Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) wrote to my father Al-Qasim Is’haq Bin Ja’far Al-Zubeyri before the death of Al-Mu’taz (the Caliph) by approximately twenty days: ‘Stay in your house until the event occurs’. So when Bureyha was killed, he wrote to him<sup>asws</sup>: ‘The event has occurred, so what are you<sup>asws</sup> ordering me with?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘This is not the event. It is another event’. So when it was from the matter of Al-Mu’taz what was’.
And from him who said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> wrote to another man: ‘He would be killed, Ibn Muhammad Bin Dawood Abdullah’, ten days before he was killed. So when it was the tenth day, he was killed’.
en.sarwar: Thereafter, there was nothing more important to me than to ask more about him and investigate his affairs. Whoever of the members of Hashite clan or the guards, the clerks, the judges, the scholars of the law (Fuqha’) and other people that I would ask I would find him being glorified, mentioned with greatness and high position. I would hear very beautiful words about him and see him given preference over all members of Hashimite clan, their elders. The feeling of greatness for him increased in my heart because I would not find anyone of his friends or foe that would not speak good of him and praise him.” A certain person from the al-Asha‘ari beliefs present asked him, “What is the news about his brother, Ja‘far, O abu Bakr?” He said, “Who is Ja‘far that you would ask about him or compare him with al-Hassan (a.s.). Ja‘far was an evil doer in public, polluted with sins, an addict drukered, the lowest of all man and the most humiliating of his own self among men. He was worthless and little to his own self. What happened durinng the time of the death of al-Hassan ibn Ali to the Sultan and his people astonished me and I did not think such thing can happen. When became ill. My father was informed that ibn al-Rida has become ill. He immediately rode to reach the capital of the Caliphate. He came back in hurry with five people of the servants of the Amir al-Mu’minin. They all were of his confidants and trustworthy ones among whom one was Nihriyr. He (my father) commanded them to stay close to the house of al-Hassan (a.s.) to learn about him and his conditions. He called a few physicians and commanded them to maintain contact with him and be around him mornings and evenings. After two or three days he was informed that he (the patient) is weakening. He commanded the physicians to remain around his house and sent for the chief judge who came in his presence. He then commanded the him (judge) to select ten persons from his most trust worthy in the matters of their religion, trust and restraint. They were called in his presence and he sent them to house of al-Hassan (a.s.). He commanded them to be there day and night and they were there until he (a.s.) passed away. The city of Surra man Ra‘a turned into one huge voice of weeping and lamentation. The Sultan sent people to search his house and search all the rooms therein and seal the contents thereof.. They searched for his son and called certain women with knowledge to deal with pregnancy. They examined his ladies. A certain woman had said that one of the ladies is pregnant. She was accommodated in a certain quarter and Nihrir, al-Khadim and his people and the women with him were ordered to stay guard around her. Thereafter they began to prepare for the burial. The markets were to remain closed. Members of the clan al-Hashim, the guards, my father and other people formed the burial procession. The city of Surra man Ra’a on that day had turned into a day similar to the Day of resurrection. When the body was readied for burial the Sultan sent message to abu ‘Isa ibn al-Mutawakkil and commanded him to lead the prayer. When the body was placed at the prayer area abu ‘Isa went close and uncovered his face. He then asked all members of al-Hashim clan of the ‘Aliwid and ‘Abbassid branch, the guards, the clerks, the judges and juries to bear witness that al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Muhammad ibn al-Rida (a.s.) his died a natural death in his own bed. That this has taken place in the presence of the servants of Amir al-Mu’minin, his confidants, so and so persons of the judges and so and persons of the physicians. He (abu ‘Isa) then covered his face and ordered to pick up the body. The body was then picked up from the central area of the house and was buried in the room where his father was buried. After his burial the Sultan and people began to search for his son. The search was carried out extensively. All the houses and rooms were searched. The distribution of his legacy was suspended. The people appointed to guard one the ladies who was thought of as pregnant continued their task until it was found out that such thought was invalid. When pregnancy was proved invalid they distributed his legacy between his mother and brother, Ja‘far. His mother claimed to be the executor of his will and her claim was confirmed before the judge. The Sultan, even after searching so much for his son continued his search to find traces of his son. Thereafter, Ja‘far came to my father and asked, “Assign the position of my brother to me. I will pay you twenty thousand Dinars every year.” My father treated him harshly and rebuked him saying, “You are a fool. The Sultan puts to the sword whoever he just thinks is a Shi‘a, follower and supporter of your father and brother to stop them from holding such belief but he fails to achieve such goal. Had you been considered an Imam among the Shi‘a of your father and brother you would not need any help from the Sultan or others to give you such position as that of your father and brother. If you are not considered an Imam among the Shi‘a of your father and brother you will not have such position from us.” My father belittled him considered him weak and ordered his people to keep him away from his office. My father did not give him permission for a meeting as long as he lived. We left and he remained in the same condition. The Sultan still would search for the traces of the son of al-Hassan ibn Ali (a.s.).”
